# coolify_server_cloudflare_tunnel (Resource)

Manages whether a Coolify server uses a Cloudflare tunnel. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0. Destroy sets is_cloudflare_tunnel to false.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_server_cloudflare_tunnel" "example" {
  server_uuid          = coolify_server.example.uuid
  is_cloudflare_tunnel = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_cloudflare_tunnel` (Boolean) Whether Cloudflare tunnel is enabled on the server.
- `server_uuid` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_server_cloudflare_tunnel.example <server-uuid>
```
